rv.q: The svelte nature of the scenes also serves the humor, of which there is plenty.
It’s one production that audiences won’t soon forget.

This play undoubtedly will resonate strongly with anyone affected by alcoholism. At the same time, the production too often is content to simply skim the surface of addiction without providing meaningful further exploration.
This is 90 minutes ( no intermission) of sheer artistry in storytelling and although it is not typical holiday fare, is indeed a play that you should try to see.
Combined with a great script and well-paced, polished production, it seems destined to be a hit.

cn.t: Critics praise "When Harry Met Rehab" as a meaningful and charming world premiere that balances humor with emotional depth, commending its well-paced storytelling of sports personality Harry Teinowitz's real-life journey through addiction and recovery.
